blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Low-cost multi-zone single-photon avalanche diode (SPAD) sensors provide compact time-of-flight measurements but are limited by sparse sampling and unreliable depth estimates near geometric discontinuities. This letter presents a reliability-aware reconstruction framework for V-shaped surfaces using two complementary TMF8821 acquisition configurations. Point-wise reliability is learned from sensor confidence, transient peak amplitude, and peak sharpness, and is incorporated into a graph-based depth optimization. The reconstructed geometry is evaluated by robust two-plane fitting and a perpendicular cross-section. Experiments on 60-degree, 90-degree, and 120-degree targets reduce the mean V-angle error from 11.21 degrees to 9.66 degrees (13.8%). For the representative 90-degree target, the combined point-to-plane RMSE decreases from 14.56 mm to 13.65 mm.
blocks.zh: 低成本的多区单磷雪崩二极管(SPAD)传感器提供了紧凑的飞行时间测量数据,但由于采样稀少和接近几何断层的深度估计不可靠而受到限制。 此字母为V形面使用两个互补的TMF8821获取配置提供了可靠意识的重建框架. 点的可靠性是从传感器的置信度,瞬态峰值振幅,峰值锐度等学来的,并融入了基于图表的深度优化. 重建后的几何学通过坚固的双平面搭配和一个垂直截面来评价. 在60度,90度,120度目标上的实验将平均V角误差从11.21度降至9.66度(13.8%). 对于代表性的90度目标,综合点对点RMSE从14.56毫米下降到13.65毫米.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Time-of-flight (ToF) sensing is widely used for three-dimensional (3-D)
perception. Single-photon avalanche diode (SPAD) sensors are attractive
because of their single-photon sensitivity and high temporal resolution [ 1 , 2 ] . Computational single-photon
imaging has further demonstrated recovery of depth and reflectivity from
sparse photon measurements by exploiting spatial and transient information [ 3 , 4 , 5 ] .
blocks.zh:
飞行时间感应被广泛用于三维(3-D)
感觉。 单光子雪崩二极管传感器有吸引力
因为它们的单光子敏感度和高时间分辨率[1,2]. 计算单photon
成像进一步证明了从中恢复深度和反射性。
通过利用空间和瞬时信息进行稀疏的光子测量[3、4、5]。

blocks.en:
Accurate reconstruction remains difficult near sharp depth transitions,
where mixed returns can produce erroneous or “flying” measurements [ 6 ] . This is especially relevant for V-shaped
surfaces, whose two planar faces meet at a sharp fold. Compact multi-zone
dToF sensors such as the TMF8821 integrate SPAD detection, TDC circuitry,
histogram processing, and distance/confidence output in a low-cost module [ 7 ] ; however, their sparse spatial sampling limits direct
surface recovery.

blocks.en:
This letter proposes a reliability-aware reconstruction framework that
aggregates two complementary acquisition configurations and learns
point-wise reliability from confidence, transient peak amplitude, and peak
sharpness. Reliability-weighted graph optimization refines the measured
depth while preserving transient and local geometric consistency. The main
contribution is the use of transient-derived, learnable reliability to guide
geometric refinement of sparse low-cost SPAD measurements. Experiments on 60 ∘ 60^{\circ} , 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} , and 120 ∘ 120^{\circ} V-shaped targets reduce the mean
angular error from 11.21 ∘ 11.21^{\circ} to 9.66 ∘ 9.66^{\circ} ( 13.8 % 13.8\% ).

blocks.en: 2 Reliability-Aware SPAD Surface Reconstruction
blocks.zh: 2 可靠性- 意识 SPAD 地面重建

blocks.en:
The proposed framework reconstructs V-shaped surfaces from sparse
multi-zone SPAD measurements by jointly exploiting depth and transient
information. Measurements acquired under two sensor configurations are
first aggregated into a common point set. Transient-derived features are
then used to estimate the reliability of each depth measurement.
Finally, the measured depth is refined through a graph-based optimization
that balances measurement fidelity, local geometric consistency, and
transient peak-position consistency. The overall processing pipeline is shown in Fig. 1 .

blocks.en: 2.1 Multi-Configuration SPAD Acquisition
blocks.zh: 2.1 多构型 SPAD 购置

blocks.en:
The measurement setup employs a TMF8821 multi-zone direct
time-of-flight (dToF) sensor to acquire both depth and transient photon
histograms from the target surface. The sensor is operated using two
custom acquisition configurations, denoted as Configurations B and C,
to provide complementary spatial sampling of the scene. Both
configurations are defined over a 16 × 10 16\times 10 logical sampling grid and
are executed sequentially using 20 measurement masks. Each acquisition
frame uses one measurement per mask after a 5-ms settling interval.
Measurements with confidence below 75 or nonpositive range are discarded
before reconstruction.

blocks.en: 4 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 4 结论

blocks.en:
A reliability-aware framework for V-shaped surface reconstruction using a
low-cost multi-zone SPAD sensor was presented. Across 60 ∘ 60^{\circ} , 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} , and 120 ∘ 120^{\circ} targets, the mean V-angle error decreased from 11.21 ∘ 11.21^{\circ} to 9.66 ∘ 9.66^{\circ} ( 13.8 % 13.8\% ); for the representative 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} target, point-to-plane RMSE decreased from 14.56 14.56 mm to 13.65 13.65 mm. The results demonstrate the benefit of transient-derived
reliability for sparse SPAD reconstruction.
